chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“If the muhrim removes ticks from his camel, there is no harm in that, but he should not remove lice.”

key_terms.الْحَلَمَةَ: lice or a small parasitic insect that should not be removed
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: What may a muhrim remove from his camel while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what is allowed for a person in ihram regarding pests found on their riding animal. It permits removing ticks from the camel while prohibiting removing lice, showing that the rulings of ihram include specific restrictions and allowances.
